## What changed and why?

Describe the problem and the behavior after this change. Link any related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test -- --test-coverage-include=src/** --test-coverage-lines=85` passes on Node.js 22.8+.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] Add meaningful tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Add an `[Unreleased]` entry for user-facing changes, or explain the skip.
- [ ] Keep `README.md` and `README.tr.md` in sync when changing documented behavior.
- [ ] Run `npm run demo` if the demo command, fixture, or output changes.
- [ ] `npm run demo:check` passes.

Include relevant output and any remaining limitations. Use anonymized examples without credentials or private data.
